title: SharePoint: automatically archive inactive files with an Advanced Management policy
summary: The briefing passes: the preview controls, licensing prerequisites and storage billing statements are supported by Microsoft documentation. It correctly reports the conflicting default thresholds and OneDrive scope descriptions rather than assuming either is settled.

claims.quote: Specifies an array of file extensions to include in the policy, in dot-prefixed format (for example, .docx). Only files matching the specified extensions are considered for archiving.

claims.claim: Archive storage consumption is billed per GB per month.

claims.claim: The storage meter charges only when archived plus active storage exceeds licensed tenant SharePoint storage capacity.
claims.quote: This meter is charged only when archived storage plus active storage in SharePoint exceeds the included or licensed allocated SharePoint storage capacity limit of the tenant.

claims.claim: The pricing page's billing scenarios use $0.05/GB/month.
claims.quote: Pay at $0.05/GB/month for 200 GB of archive storage.

claims.claim: Monthly archive usage counts archived sites plus archived files in non-archived SharePoint sites.
claims.quote: Monthly archive storage usage is calculated as the total of two components: (1) the storage used by all archived SharePoint sites, and (2) the storage used by archived files that reside in non-archived SharePoint sites.

claims.claim: Archived content remains archived if Archive is disabled or its billing is unhealthy.

claims.claim: Archived content can still be reactivated when Archive or its billing is unavailable.

claims.claim: New archive actions are blocked until Archive is enabled and billing is healthy.
claims.quote: New archive actions are blocked until Microsoft 365 Archive is turned on and billing is healthy.

claims.claim: Archived content counts as active storage while Archive or billing is unavailable.
claims.quote: While Microsoft 365 Archive or billing is unavailable, archived content counts as active storage usage and counts toward standard Microsoft 365 storage consumption.

claims.where: Scope; Why it matters; front matter: defaultState; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The policy is admin-opt-in: enabling Archive alone does not create a policy, and a created policy requires activation.
claims.quote: The current preview requires SharePoint Advanced Management entitlement and PowerShell configuration; enabling Archive alone doesn't create a policy.

claims.claim: For more than 100,000 sites, Microsoft directs administrators to create a new matching policy with IsWhatIfMode false for enforcement.
claims.quote: If your policy covers more than 100,000 sites, create a new policy with the same criteria, scope, and site inclusions or exclusions when you're ready to archive files. Set IsWhatIfMode to $false on the new policy.

claims.claim: Switching an existing simulation policy to enforcement resumes processing and might skip sites already evaluated in simulation.
claims.quote: Switching the existing simulation policy to archiving resumes from its previous processing position instead of starting over, so sites already evaluated in simulation might be skipped.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: New-SPOFileArchivePolicy -PolicyType SelectedSites -LastAccessDateCriteria 12 creates the scoped policy with a 12-month threshold.
claims.quote: New-SPOFileArchivePolicy -PolicyType "SelectedSites" -Name "ArchiveMarketing" -LastAccessDateCriteria 12

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Set-SPOFileArchivePolicy -PolicyId <policy GUID> -State Active activates the identified policy.
claims.quote:
Set-SPOFileArchivePolicy -PolicyId "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890" -State "Active"
Activates the specified file archive policy.

claims.where: controls[2].api; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Set-SPOFileArchivePolicy -PolicyId <policy GUID> -IsWhatIfMode $false disables simulation for the identified policy.
claims.quote:
-PolicyId <Guid> ... [-IsWhatIfMode <Boolean>]
When set to $false, the policy archives files normally when active.

claims.where: controls[3].api; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Add-SPOSiteToFileArchivePolicy -PolicyId <policy GUID> -Site <site URL> -Exclude adds an exclusion for AllSites or AllODBSites.
claims.quote:
Add-SPOSiteToFileArchivePolicy -PolicyId <Guid> -Site <SpoSitePipeBind> [-Exclude]
Use this parameter only with a policy whose PolicyType is AllSites or AllODBSites. Omit it when adding sites to a SelectedSites policy.

claims.where: controls[4].api; controls[4].note; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Get-SPOFileArchivePolicyReport -PolicyId <policy GUID> retrieves read-only reports for the preceding 12 months.
claims.quote:
Get-SPOFileArchivePolicyReport -PolicyId "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
Returns all run reports for the specified file archive policy from the past 12 months.

claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint inactive files policy admin center UI create activate simulation site exclusions reports PowerShell only; opened manage-inactive-files and New-SPOFileArchivePolicy. The feature page states PowerShell is the only supported management experience.

claims.claim: No admin UI for switching policy simulation and enforcement is documented for the current preview.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint inactive files policy admin center UI create activate simulation site exclusions reports PowerShell only; opened manage-inactive-files and Set-SPOFileArchivePolicy. The feature page states PowerShell is the only supported management experience.

claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint inactive files policy admin center UI create activate simulation site exclusions reports PowerShell only; opened manage-inactive-files and Add-SPOSiteToFileArchivePolicy. The feature page states PowerShell is the only supported management experience.

claims.claim: No admin UI for reviewing inactive files policy run reports is documented for the current preview.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The licensing model is mixed, combining SAM entitlement with metered Microsoft 365 Archive storage.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Archive is billed based on the number of gigabytes (GB) archived. ... The current preview requires SharePoint Advanced Management entitlement and PowerShell configuration

claims.claim: A SelectedSites policy requires an included site before activation, and omitting Exclude adds an inclusion only for that policy type.
claims.quote: By default, the site is added as an inclusion. Inclusions are only valid for a policy whose PolicyType is SelectedSites, and at least one site must be added before such a policy can be activated.

claims.claim: The New-SPOFileArchivePolicy reference says the omitted inactivity threshold defaults to 18 months.
claims.quote: This parameter has no PowerShell-side default. When omitted, the service applies an inactivity threshold of 18 months to the new policy.

claims.claim: The feature page instead says the default inactivity threshold is 24 months.
claims.quote: The policy commands accept an inactivity threshold from 6 through 48 months. The default is 24 months.

claims.claim: A site exclusion affects future processing by that policy only.
claims.quote: A site exclusion affects future processing by that policy.

claims.claim: Excluding a site does not reactivate its already archived files.
claims.quote: It doesn't reactivate files already archived, reverse previous policy actions, or exempt the site from another archive policy or manual archiving method.

claims.claim: Disabling the user-facing Archive action does not prevent automatic policies from archiving files.
claims.quote: Manual file archiving and automatic policy archiving are separate controls. Disabling the user-facing Archive action doesn't prevent automatic policies from archiving files.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Setting State to Inactive stops the policy.
claims.quote:
To make a policy inactive:
Set-SPOFileArchivePolicy -PolicyId $policyId -State "Inactive"

claims.claim: New-SPOFileArchivePolicy can create a SelectedSites pilot with IsWhatIfMode explicitly set to true.
claims.quote: New-SPOFileArchivePolicy -Name "MarketingInactiveFilesPreview" -PolicyType "SelectedSites" -LastAccessDateCriteria 12 -FileTypeCriteria @(".docx", ".pdf") -IsWhatIfMode $true

claims.claim: The variable cost rating reflects the documented archive storage meter.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Archive charges you for storage. Storage consumption is charged at a per-GB monthly rate.
